chapter: Chicago and Oliver's band in California
title: Ben Borders and the first records for Sunshine
summary: Ben Borders liked the band and made their first records in 1921 for the Spikes Brothers, with singers Roberta and Ruth Lee.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Don't call me New York. I'm a cracker. Where was Ben Borders home? Do you know? Oh, Ben.
Yeah. Well, what's Ben? Ben. I think Ben Borders was somewhere down in Texas. Yeah.
In Texas. You don't know what Borders is?
No, I don't.
I just wondered how you happened to get tied up with him so early out there in California.
Oh, Ben was crazy about the band. He made the record with us, the first records we ever made. Oh, really? The Sunshine.
Mm-hmm.
Oh, yeah. That was the ones with the singers and the ones...
Well, for Red Spike, for the Spike Brothers.
Yeah, yeah.
Them, the first records we made.
You like those singers?
The Sunset. Huh?
You like those women that sang with you?
Yeah.
We have one of those on...
On Sunset?
Yeah, up at Tulane, yeah. That Sweet Something dance.
Alberta, I think one of them was... Roberta. Roberta.
Yeah, and there was one other woman, Ruth Lee.
Ruth Lee.
Yeah.
Roberta and Ruth Lee.
Yeah, I think we got one on the same.
Some Day Sweetheart. Yeah.
I think that had a verse and all, too.
It was Some Rainy Day, it was. And they changed the title. Oh.
